reports.headline: A Black Stone in the Pasture
reports.body: Overnight a stone stood up in the grazing land {dir} of the village {dist}: tall, black, and humming. The {animal} will not go near it, and {name} says something like dogs paces round it after dark, as if it were theirs to keep.

reports.headline: The Humming Stone
reports.body: Nobody put it there. A black stone {dir} of here {dist} hums when the wind drops, and since it came the {animal} have been sick. {name} saw shapes circling it at dusk and turned back.
